parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel of the Door Set, made of wood with a textured surface pattern.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer structural frame of the Door Set, made of wood, providing support and alignment for the door.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the door in place, provides structural stability, and ensures proper alignment for smooth operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or doorway structure.

parts.name: Voice Box (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is an auxiliary component of the Door Set, likely a voice communication or intercom unit made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It allows communication through the door, often used for security or visitor identification purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move, but may contain internal electronic components that function when activated.
